14 ([[Village of Despair]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]40,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slow |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Rock Throw}}''' - Throws a rock at a tower, stunning it for a long period of time. |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Sword Swing}}''' - Swings its sword in a 180° arc, stunning all towers hit. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Hero''' was an ice elemental [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in [[Village of Despair]] as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. It also used to spawn in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Legacy Hidden Wave]] which meant it could spawn on [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Due to its high health, it posed a significant threat despite its slow speed. The '''Frost Hero''' also possessed two abilities capable of stunning towers: the ''Rock Throw'' ability which inflicted a prolonged stun on a single tower, and the ''Sword Swing'' ability which could stun a group of towers. ==Appearance== The '''Frost Hero''' was quite a large [[Enemies|enemy]], about the same size as the [[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]]. It had a blue frost mask and helmet, dark blue granite wings, full blue armor (including chestplate, shoulder-pads and leggings). It also wielded a sword. It had a drooling zombie face and blue skin. Its torso and legs were black. ==Strategy== *The [[Electroshocker]] can be used to slow the '''Frost Hero''' down to allow your towers more time to kill it. **The [[Freezer]] and [[Frost Blaster]] can actually be quite useful against this [[Enemies|enemy]] as it is not immune to their freeze. ***However, due to the '''Frost Hero's''' size, these towers can only slow it down for a short period of time compared to an average-sized enemy. *Cheap towers, such as the [[Scout]], can be used to distract this enemy, keeping your main towers attacking it. **However, this wastes a tower slot in the late game which can be used for towers that deal more damage. *You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to cleanse towers, if they were stunned by the '''Frost Hero''', so long the [[Medic]] isn't stunned itself. *As usual, high DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Turret]], are recommended against this enemy. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Frost Hero Old.png|First version, first animation (29 December 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Hero''' was loosely based on the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Titan|Titan]] from ''Tower Battles'' in terms of abilities. *A version of the [[Frost Hero (Pre-MEGA)|Frost Hero]] existed before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], though it was completely different to this variant of the '''Frost Hero'''. ==Update History== *'''24 December 2019''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.0]] **'''Frost Hero''' added. *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]] **'''Frost Hero''' removed from [[Village of Despair]]. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animations changed. **{{Bug}} ''Rock Throw'' cannot be seen, but can still stun towers. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Frost Hero''' removed and replaced by [[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)]] in [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]]. {{HiddenWave|[[SCT]]|Frost Hero
